title: scorzonera mollis subsp. idaea
intro: Scorzonera mollis subsp. idaea, commonly known as Idaea Scorzonera, is a type of perennial plant belonging to the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, inflammation, and skin problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Idaea Scorzonera include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
